title: Psalms Bible Quiz - Chapter 125
description: Ten questions on Psalms 125: those who trust in Yahweh are like Mount Zion, and Yahweh surrounds his people as the mountains surround Jerusalem.

questions.text: What are those who trust in Yahweh like, according to verse 1?
questions.explanation: Psalms 125:1 says "Those who trust in Yahweh are as Mount Zion."

questions.text: What does verse 1 say about Mount Zion?
questions.explanation: Psalms 125:1 says Mount Zion can't be moved, but remains forever.

answers.text: It is covered with snow all year
It is higher than all the other mountains
It can't be moved, but remains forever

questions.text: What do the mountains surround, according to verse 2?
questions.explanation: Psalms 125:2 says "As the mountains surround Jerusalem."

questions.text: Whom does Yahweh surround, as the mountains surround Jerusalem?
questions.explanation: Psalms 125:2 says "so Yahweh surrounds his people from this time forward and forever more."

questions.text: Which scepter won't remain over the allotment of the righteous?
questions.explanation: Psalms 125:3 says "the scepter of wickedness won't remain over the allotment of the righteous."

questions.text: Over what will the scepter of wickedness not remain?
questions.explanation: Psalms 125:3 says it won't remain over the allotment of the righteous.

answers.text: The land of the faraway nations

questions.text: Why will the scepter of wickedness not remain there, according to verse 3?
questions.explanation: Psalms 125:3 says it is "so that the righteous won't use their hands to do evil."

answers.text: So that the land can rest and lie fallow in the seventh year
So that the poor can eat from the fields
So that the temple can be built again
So that the righteous won't use their hands to do evil

questions.text: Verse 4 asks Yahweh to do good to those who are good and to whom else?
questions.explanation: Psalms 125:4 says "Do good, Yahweh, to those who are good, to those who are upright in their hearts."

answers.text: Those who are rich in the land
Those who are strong and brave in every battle
Those who are upright in their hearts
Those who live near the temple

questions.text: Whom will Yahweh lead away with the workers of iniquity?
questions.explanation: Psalms 125:5 says "as for those who turn away to their crooked ways, Yahweh will lead them away with the workers of iniquity."

answers.text: Those who turn away to their crooked ways
Those who are poor and weak
Those who travel to far lands across the sea
Those who live by the sea

questions.text: With which words does the psalm end?
questions.explanation: Psalms 125:5 ends with "Peace be on Israel."
